message: Hey, VC, thanks. As I incompletely hinted [here](/weblog/archives/2005/11/03/and-plagiarize-we-did/), students made some judgments about the sorts of sources the sample student essay cited, so yes there was some evaluation going on, and a lot of it came out in classroom discussion as well in terms of judging the appropriatness of certain sources for the audience addressed. But, yes, it's definitely important, and we'll be following up on the [homework questions](http://rhetcomp.net/113/archives/2005/11/homework_for_co_1.html) about the nature of sources next week.
